description: React component implementing a rich text editor with custom toolbar, selection handling, and raw data display, using draft-js library.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main React component managing the rich text editor, toolbar positioning, and selection logic.

classes.name: ToolbarButton
classes.description: Component representing individual toolbar buttons for styling text.

methods.name: onClickEditor
methods.description: Handles click on editor to focus and check selected text.

methods.name: checkSelectedText
methods.description: Checks if any text is selected and updates toolbar visibility.

methods.name: setSelectionXY
methods.description: Calculates and sets the selection coordinates and measures.

methods.name: showToolbar
methods.description: Sets state to display the toolbar.

methods.name: measureToolbar
methods.description: Measures toolbar dimensions after it becomes visible.

methods.name: setToolbarXY
methods.description: Calculates and sets the toolbar position based on selection.

methods.name: handleKeyCommand
methods.description: Handles keyboard commands for inline styling.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the editor, toolbar, and raw data toggle button.
